name: sec-financials
description: As-reported financial data from SEC EDGAR for any US public company. Pulls income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and notes directly from XBRL filings.

tools.name: start_company
tools.description: List all available statements and notes for a company

tools.name: get_statement
tools.description: Fetch a financial statement or note from a specific SEC filing

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Fetch multi-year annual history for a core statement

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List all available sections for a company

tools.name: discover
tools.description: List all notes in a specific filing category
